import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int n, m;
    static long[] freq1 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] freq2 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[][] probs = new long[10][10];
    static int[] mapper1 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] mapper2 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] mapping = new int[30];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void processSubset(int idx, List<Integer> choice, long weight) {
        if (idx == m) {
            int bit = 0, pos = 0;
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(s) != m) continue;
                List<Integer> idxs = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if (((s >> i) & 1) == 1) idxs.add(i);
                }
                Collections.sort(idxs);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k) {
                        if (((choice.get(k) >> idxs.get(k)) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) { found = true; break; }
                } while (nextPermutation(idxs));
                if (found) bit |= 1 << pos;
                ++pos;
            }
            freq1[bit] = (freq1[bit] + weight) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
            choice.add(s);
            long cur = weight;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (((s >> k) & 1) == 1)
                    cur = (cur * probs[idx][k]) % MOD;
                else
                    cur = (cur * ((MOD + 1 - probs[idx][k]) % MOD)) % MOD;
            }
            processSubset(idx + 1, choice, cur);
            choice.remove(choice.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static void processComplement(int idx, List<Integer> choice, long weight) {
        if (idx == n) {
            int bit = 0, pos = 0;
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(s) != n - m) continue;
                List<Integer> idxs = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if (((s >> i) & 1) == 1) idxs.add(i);
                }
                Collections.sort(idxs);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n - m; ++k) {
                        if (((choice.get(k) >> idxs.get(k)) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) { found = true; break; }
                } while (nextPermutation(idxs));
                if (found) bit |= 1 << pos;
                ++pos;
            }
            freq2[bit] = (freq2[bit] + weight) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
            choice.add(s);
            long cur = weight;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (((s >> k) & 1) == 1)
                    cur = (cur * probs[idx][k]) % MOD;
                else
                    cur = (cur * ((MOD + 1 - probs[idx][k]) % MOD)) % MOD;
            }
            processComplement(idx + 1, choice, cur);
            choice.remove(choice.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int i = list.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i + 1)) --i;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = list.size() - 1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) --j;
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(list.subList(i + 1, list.size()));
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probs[i][j] = (long) val * modPow(100, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                if (probs[i][j] < 0) probs[i][j] += MOD;
            }
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(probs[0][0]);
            return;
        }

        m = n / 2;
        List<Integer> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
        processSubset(0, buffer, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) freq1[i] %= MOD;

        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b) {
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << 20); ++s) {
                if (((s >> b) & 1) == 1) {
                    freq1[s] = (freq1[s] + freq1[s ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long globalSum = freq1[(1 << 20) - 1];

        buffer.clear();
        processComplement(m, buffer, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) freq2[i] %= MOD;

        Arrays.fill(mapper1, -1);
        int counter = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != m) continue;
            mapper1[s] = counter++;
        }

        Arrays.fill(mapper2, -1);
        counter = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); ++s) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(s) != n - m) continue;
            mapping[counter] = mapper1[(1 << n) - 1 - s];
            mapper2[s] = counter++;
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int s = 0; s < (1 << counter); ++s) {
            long val = freq2[s];
            int mask = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < counter; ++b) {
                if (((s >> b) & 1) == 1) continue;
                mask |= 1 << mapping[b];
            }
            result = (result + val * ((globalSum - freq1[mask] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result % MOD);
    }
}
